source.name: AirStack taxonomy ambiguity set
source.note: Cases where two categories are easy to confuse, with the node each one belongs in and why. A case names a catalog or registry product (product) or a Wikidata type from directory.json (type); expect lists the nodes, and null means the product or type must stay unplaced. backend/tests/test_taxonomy.py scores every case against taxonomy-index.json and the crosswalk walk.
